title: DDoS-AI: High-Throughput Cascading Dual-Tier Architecture for Real-Time DDoS Detection and Autonomous Mitigation in Software-Defined Networks
description:
DDoS-AI is a high-throughput network security and artificial intelligence platform designed to detect, classify, and mitigate volumetric, reflection, application-layer, and zero-day Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks across heterogeneous network environments (Enterprise Clouds, Software-Defined Networks, and IoT).

Featuring an ultra-fast sub-millisecond histogram-binned tree screening tier cascading to deep tabular residual neural networks for ambiguous high-entropy bursts, DDoS-AI delivers line-rate inspection with a 14.9x latency speedup over recurrent attention baselines while maintaining 96.09% F1-score across InSDN, CIC-DDoS2019, and enterprise traffic traces.
